description: This Java test class contains unit tests for handling static content files in a sales management system. It tests uploading, retrieving, and removing static files and images through a ContentService, including reading files from disk, converting them to byte streams, and performing operations on content stored in the system.

classes.name: StaticContentTestCase
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing content upload/download/removal functionality involving static content files and images.

methods.name: createImage
methods.description: Tests uploading, retrieving, and deleting an image file in the content management system.

methods.name: testCreateStaticContent
methods.description: Tests uploading and retrieving a static ZIP file in the system.

methods.name: testCreateMultipleStaticContent
methods.description: Tests uploading multiple static files and handling them together.
